intro.uz: Kamola Xivadan dugonasi Layloga xat yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz Xiva haqida nimalarni bilasiz?

paragraphs.en: Dear Laylo, how are you? I am in Khiva with my parents! I am sitting in a small café now, and I am writing to you.
paragraphs.uz: Qadrli Laylo, qalaysan? Men ota-onam bilan Xivadaman! Hozir kichkina kafeda oʻtiribman va senga xat yozyapman.

paragraphs.en: Khiva is an old city. There are high walls around the old part of the city. Inside, there are mosques, madrasas and a lot of little shops.
paragraphs.uz: Xiva — qadimiy shahar. Shaharning eski qismi atrofida baland devorlar bor. Ichkarida masjidlar, madrasalar va juda koʻp kichkina doʻkonlar bor.

paragraphs.en: The weather is very hot, so I wear a hat every day. The food is great. I like the green noodles here. They are called shivit oshi.
paragraphs.uz: Havo juda issiq, shuning uchun har kuni shlyapa kiyaman. Ovqatlar zoʻr. Menga bu yerdagi yashil ugra yoqadi. Uning nomi — shivit oshi.

paragraphs.en: We go home on Sunday. I would like to show you my photos. See you soon! Love, Kamola
paragraphs.uz: Biz yakshanba kuni uyga qaytamiz. Senga suratlarimni koʻrsatmoqchiman. Tez orada koʻrishguncha! Mehr bilan, Kamola
